rules_text:
Rules summary Contents 1 Goal 2 Submarines 3 Player Turn 4 Notes 5 Game End and Scoring Goal The goal of the game is to sink as many enemy or neutral submarines as possible while safeguarding as many of yours as possible. Submarines Each of the submarines has a color, and every player has a color. The player owns the submarines of their color. Player Turn On your turn you must: • Play at least 1 fleet card and move the sub of the corresponding color by the value on the card Then, you can: • Play further fleet cards (of any color) if you can connect them via fleet icons on the top-left of the card • Play a torpedo card (of any color) if you can connect it via fleet icons on the top-left of the card. Select a sub to attack OR discard the torpedo If you played a torpedo card, 1 8-sided dice will be rolled for every torpedo icon on that card. Any roll below the target sub's position on the board sinks the sub. If you sink a sub, place it in your Scoring Area. It will be worth points at the end of the game. If you miss with all your shots, place the torpedo card in your Scoring Area. It will cost you points at the end of the game. Notes Remember that fleet cards are individual, torpedo cards are common. If no submarine of the color corresponding to the card (fleet or torpedo) is on the board, the card becomes wild and you can select any sub. Game End and Scoring If all but 2 subs have been sunk, or if there are no torpedo card available to replace a used torpedo card, the game ends. Each player scores as follows: • 1 point per Sub in Scoring Area • -1 point for each Torpedo Card in Scoring Area (missed shots) • 2 points for each Surviving Sub on board • 1 point for each Sub pair of the same colour in Scoring Area • 2 points if you have four different colored subs or more in the Scoring Area

[Rating: 4/10] The theme is the lightest of veneers on this game. You are dealt 3 cards and if you get super lucky you can chain them together to get the final symbol to be something that lets you access torpedos which are a public display. the cards also move the subs back and forth making them easier or harder to hit when targeted.  I think maybe something along the lines of paying a cost (move one of your subs forward some amount to gain an advantage) to play the card and get a range modifier on the target would have been better.   The game seems fairly random and really light.

[Rating: 4/10] Kurz: Kartenglück trifft auf Würfelglück. Langform:  Jeder zieht 3 Fortbewegungskarten (vor/zurück in versch. Höhe.) Dazu werden insgesamt 3 Angriffskarten für alle offen ausgelegt. Auf beiden Karten-Typen sind eine der 6 U-Boot-Farben. Wenn man eine Fortbew.-Karte gespielt hat, kann man ggf. eine weitere Karte spielen (je nach icon).  Das machen alle abwechselnd und so lange, bis nur noch eine bestimmte Anzahl an Ubooten übrig sind. Die m.M.n. einzigen beiden taktische Kniffe sind: -wenn man man eine U-Boot-Farbe komplett eleminiert hat. (Denn dann kann man diese Farbe als Joker-Farbe nutzen)

[Rating: 5/10] A casual game, so not really to my taste. Doesn't really work thematically and has little strategy. But for those who like casual games, this is probably more fun than, say, Solitaire or Candy Crush.  Played on BGA.

[Rating: 6.5/10] Try to sink subs and save your own. I thought I would dislike this game, but I was shocked to find I kind of liked it.
